title: Trump to meet cabinet at Camp David as Iran war drags on - US politics live
summary: President grapples with finding a resolution to Middle East conflict that has pushed up gasoline prices ahead of vital midterm elections Sign up for the US Breaking News email. A new survey of voters in 18 congressional toss-up districts by the Working Families Party showed voters, and especially independents, want candidates who challenge the political system. When given a choice between a generic candidate who is an experienced elected official who focuses on "practical reforms" who gets funding from established groups and party donors, or a "political outsider who says the system is broken" who calls for changes to the status quo, the outsider wins by 14 points in the poll, including among independents and moderates. The survey found 80% of voters agreed that elected officials care more about wealthy donors and powerful interests than people like them.
